description_en: Queries the descriptions of time series metrics available in CloudMonitor
description_zh: 查询云监控开放的时序类监控项的监控项描述
kebab_example: aliyun cms query-metric-meta --project acs_ecs_dashboard --labels name_:_alertUnit_,_value_:_% --metric CPUUtilization --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --api-version 2018-03-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMetricMeta

parameters.help_en: The project to which the metric belongs. Exact match is used
parameters.help_zh: 指标所属的Project，按等于匹配
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en:
The labels used to filter metrics. Format: `[{"name":"Label name","value":"Label value"},{"name":"Label name","value":"Label value"}]`.
The following label names are available: 

MetricCategory: the category description of the metric.  
alertEnable: specifies whether alerting is required.  
alertUnit: the recommended alert unit. 
unitFactor: the unit conversion factor.  
minAlertPeriod: the minimum alert period.  
productCategory: the product type category
parameters.help_zh:
根据标签过滤，格式`[{"name":"标签名","value":"标签值"},{"name":"标签名","value":"标签值"}] `。
已有的标签name说明： 

MetricCategory：监控项分类的描述  
alertEnable：是否需要报警  
alertUnit：建议的报警单位 
unitFactor：单位转换系数  
minAlertPeriod：最小报警周期  
productCategory：产品类型分类
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: The metric name. Exact match is used
parameters.name: metric

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Default value: 30
parameters.name: page_size

ErrorCode.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success. A non-200 value indicates failure
ErrorCode.description_zh: 状态码，200为成功，非200为失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID for tracking purposes

Resource.description_en: The list of returned metric metadata

Dimensions.description_en: The dimensions of the metric. Multiple dimensions are separated by commas (,), such as userId,instanceId
Dimensions.description_zh: 监控项的Dimensions，多级用英文逗号分隔，例如：userId,instanceId

Labels.description_en:
The labels of the metric. The value is a JSON string in the format `[{"name":"Label name","value":"Label value"}]`. Multiple labels are supported, and the name can be repeated.
The following label names are available: 

metricCategory: the metric category. 
alertEnable: specifies whether alerting is supported.  
alertUnit: the alert unit. 
unitFactor: the unit conversion factor. 
minAlertPeriod: the minimum alert period. 
productCategory: the product
Labels.description_zh:
监控项的标签，是一个json的string`[{"name":"标签名","value":"标签的值"}]`，可以是多个，name可以重复。
已有的标签name说明： 

metricCategory：指标分类 
alertEnable：是否可以报警  
alertUnit：报警单位 
unitFactor：单位转换系数 
minAlertPeriod：最小报警周期 
productCategory：产品

Periods.description_en: All statistical periods of the metric. Multiple periods are separated by commas (,), such as 15,60,900
Periods.description_zh: 监控项的所有统计周期，多个用英文逗号分隔：15,60,900

Project.description_en: The project name of the metric, which is used to query monitoring data
Project.description_zh: 监控项的Project名称，用于查询监控数据

Statistics.description_en: The statistical methods. Multiple methods are separated by commas (,), such as Maximum,Minimum,Average
Statistics.description_zh: 统计方法，多个用英文逗号分隔，例如：Maximum,Minimum,Average

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
Success.description_zh: 用于标识本次调用是否成功
